review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001 through AC-003 consistently require a readonly live status getter, response-reassignment behavior, and compatibility including compile-time assignment rejection. The exact writable owner scope contains the implementation and both regression files without requiring edits to unrelated consumers or generated declarations. The supplied configuration supports separate runtime and compile-time verification: test-d is included by tsconfig.test.json, and the build produces distribution from source. TASK-IMPLEMENT and the dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY are consistent with the specification; their allowed agents have the relevant active project-scoped trusted claims, including data.change, domain.state, integration.consumer, TypeScript, and the applicable testing capabilities. Pending legacy claims and persona descriptions are not needed to establish eligibility. An independent active reviewer is configured for the earlier risk-review prerequisite. No material unresolved DEC-001 or other decision input is supplied, so ready with no blocking reasons is appropriate. Repository identity, base commit, required evidence stages, and frozen release fingerprints agree across Gold and preview. The supplied provenance explains the distinct source-digest domains and PRD trimming, while isolation evidence states that Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle. I relied on the Service-supplied fingerprint bindings and preparation evidence; I did not recompute digests, execute code, or provide human attestation. The original specification's preparation placeholders do not contradict the subsequently supplied frozen preview inputs.
